title: Help
contactTitle: Let’s make your next step easier.
contactDescription: Find quick answers about using the guide and templates.
startAnswer: Start by setting up your organisation. To explore the content first, open requirement 4 in the guide.
sgiQuestion: What is an Integrated Management System?
sgiAnswer: It is a way to manage quality, environment, and occupational health and safety processes together. Choose the areas you want to implement.
templatesQuestion: How do I use the templates?
templatesAnswer: On the Templates page, choose a document and select Download. Open it with the suggested software and adapt it to your organisation.
dataAnswer: After creating an account, your organisation details, representative, and chosen systems are saved on the server and linked to your profile. Before then, the draft exists only for this session.
contactIntro: A place for questions about the platform.
contactUnavailable: Sending messages is not available yet. For now, please consult the guidance on this page.
myContactsText: The guide explains each step and brings together supporting documents.
